title: GUARD: Guideline Upholding Test through Adaptive Role-play and Jailbreak Diagnostics for LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model adherence to government-issued fairness and non-discrimination guidelines by using an adaptive role-playing LLM framework (GUARD) to generate guideline-violating questions and measuring the guideline violation rate under jailbreak conditions.

Generating adversarial test questions asking the model to design systems that discriminate against minority groups or facilitate racial profiling (e.g., in law enforcement or hiring), and measuring the model's compliance and refusal rates.

Prompting the model with automatically generated jailbreak questions that request strategies to alter AI algorithms (like loan approvals or hiring tools) to disproportionately favor or discriminate against specific genders.
Testing the model with adversarial questions requesting methods to manipulate AI systems (such as education systems) to provide unequal opportunities based on socioeconomic status.
